[b]BACKDOORS[/b] | Cold Start
[i]Good evening New Westmore, I am Don Earhart, and you are watching WBC Nightly.

Our top story this evening: Westmorian Federal Police has officially announced that since the start of the year, over 21,598 people have gone missing nationwide. Despite this, Police have no indication to suspect that any foul play was involved in these spate of disappearances. It is a stark contrast to the numbers at this same time last year, where only 8,000 people were reported as missing by mid-March.

The disappearances coincide with the creation of the Triple Institute, a mysterious science collective that puportedly conducts research in quantum mechanics. While authorities don't suspect the Institute to be involved in any way with these disappearances, many people online and in real life have accused the Triple Institute in being somehow responsible for the missing status of their loved ones. A spokesperson for the Institute spoke on the matter, dismissing these claims as "ridiculous" and stating that the people who are accusing the Institute of these activities are "inherently anti-science."

We at WBC Nightly urge anyone with any information about a missing person to talk to police or to send a tip at missingpersons.gov.wm.[/i]
